theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mono_truncated_mean_curvature
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∃ H : Euclid P → Euclid P, AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure ∧ (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ K → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
